channel.title: Hastings Daily: Business
channel.description: Local news for Hastings, St Leonards, Rye, Bexhill and Battle, three times a day.

item.title: Nineteen-year-old opens her own beauty salon in Bexhill
item.description: Grace Guenigault, 19, has opened her own beauty salon in Bexhill, the Hastings Observer reported.

item.title: Camber Sands holiday park ranked among worst in UK
item.description: Camber Sands Holiday Park, near Rye, has been named one of the lowest-rated holiday parks in the country.

item.title: St Leonards and Hastings properties sell at Clive Emson auction
item.description: A mixed-use property at 32 Kings Road, St Leonards, has been sold before the auction in one of the latest Clive Emson Auctioneers sales, which listed 174 lots across southern England.

item.title: Fire-hit St Leonards convent site goes to auction at £1.7m
item.description: A former convent in St Leonards that was damaged in a major fire earlier this summer is going on the market, with a guide price of £1.7 million and a potential major housing scheme for the land.

item.title: The Plough in Rye named among Britain's best pubs
item.description: A pub in Rye has been named among the best in the country, with recognition for what the guide calls an unpretentious country pub.

item.title: Plans for up to 125 homes at Robertsbridge mill site
item.description: Proposals to build up to 125 homes on the Hodson's Mill site in Robertsbridge are set to go before Rother District Council's planning committee on Thursday, 12 November. The plans come from Homes England, the government's housing and regeneration agency.

item.title: Hole Park near Rye promises a top Christmas tree crop after summer drought
item.description: One of the Rye area's longest established Christmas tree growers is promising a top-quality harvest for the second year in a row.

item.title: Work begins on 27 'luxury flats' development in St Leonards
item.description: Work has started on a scheme of 27 flats in St Leonards. Scaffolding is going up and the first foundations are being built on a West Hill Road site, according to the Hastings Observer.

item.title: Self-storage operator opens 44th site on Sedlescombe Road, St Leonards
item.description: Self-storage specialist Cuboid Self Storage has opened its second site in Sussex, on Sedlescombe Road in St Leonards-on-Sea. The facility opened on 1 November and is the company's 44th site nationwide, joining its existing facility in Shoreham.

item.title: Update: Developers reveal bid to build 120 new Hastings homes
item.description: Catesby Estates and Rurban Estates are now inviting people to have a say on the proposals before finalising them and submitting planning applications to Hastings Borough Council and Rother District Council. The development would include approximately 120 new homes, of which 30 per cent would be affordable housing, a care home, a new landscaped public open green space and children's play area. Many readers have voiced concerns about traffic on The Ridge and pressure on local services, according to the Hastings Observer. Feedback can be shared via a consultation at www.catesby-hastings.co.uk.

item.title: Cooden Beach Golf Club seeks permission for homes on part of its course
item.description: Cooden Beach Golf Club is seeking planning permission to build housing on part of its course on Cooden Sea Road, according to an application to Rother District Council.

item.title: Developers reveal bid to build 120 new Hastings homes
item.description: Catesby Estates and Rurban Estates have revealed a bid to build about 120 new homes in Hastings.

item.title: Hastings pizzeria Monellis named best in the world for 2026
item.description: Monellis Sourdough Pizza, a family-run pizzeria in Hastings Old Town, has been named the best in the world for 2026, topping The World's 100 Best Pizzerias, a list compiled by international travel and venue-ranking platform Worth a Journey.

item.title: Vacant Bexhill bank building to become two restaurants and eight flats
item.description: Plans to convert the former Lloyds Bank building in Bexhill town centre into two restaurants and eight apartments have been unveiled.

item.title: Hastings business group welcomes Budget rates relief package
item.description: Business representatives in Hastings have welcomed the government's package of rates relief for small businesses, announced by the chancellor, John Healey, in his Autumn Budget on Wednesday.

item.title: One in ten young adults in Hastings on unemployment benefits
item.description: More than one in ten young adults in Hastings are claiming unemployment-related benefits, Office for National Statistics figures show, according to The Argus.

item.title: Council's free business support pilot to visit Hastings Old Town and Rye high streets
item.description: A new free business support pilot will reach independent shops and businesses in selected East Sussex high streets, including Hastings Old Town and Rye, the county council said.
